answer: Work waits on the orchard until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the timber of the next round. By the forge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
